Donald Trump lashed out toward the end of the final presidential debate on Wednesday.
The Republican presidential nominee went after Hillary Clinton when she explained her tax plan, pointing out that she would raise taxes on top earners like herself and Trump.
"We need to put more money into social security trust funds.
That's part of my commitment to raise taxes on the wealthy.
My social security payroll contribution will go up, as will Donald's assuming he can't figure out how to get out of it," Clinton said.
The comment quickly lit up social media, and the Clinton campaign quickly slammed Trump online over his off-the-cuff comment.
